properties.label: Value / representation
properties.definition: Returned values, result structure, canonical forms, or preserved text differ.

properties.label: Call compatibility
properties.definition: An existing API handles a declared argument form, callback binding, or dispatch path incompatibly.

properties.label: Validation / exceptions
properties.definition: Input acceptance, rejection, or required exception behavior differs.

properties.label: Evaluation control
properties.definition: Whether or when an operand, callback, or branch executes differs.

properties.label: Ordering / identity
properties.definition: Observable order, identity, or identity-based lookup differs.

properties.label: State / lifecycle
properties.definition: Observable state evolution, object lifetime, reset, or cleanup differs.

properties.label: Defaults / precedence
properties.definition: Default selection, fallback, or precedence among supplied values differs.

properties.label: Interaction protocol
properties.definition: Available operations violate an explicit sequencing or interaction invariant.
